apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 175 (1.1.175) replaces the unavailable system Metal HUD overlay with an in-app client display timing diagnostic in the stream Picture panel. It reports screen maximum, requested display range, measured CADisplayLink callback cadence and interval range, and actual drawable presentation FPS. This works in KravaSigner-installed builds; these are client timings, not a direct physical panel-Hz reading or proof of server-side G-Sync acceptance. Includes the Metal 4 triple-buffer activation fix and Cloud G-Sync request wiring. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
